description: Candidate bounty/contest programs to rank via scripts/target_acquisition.py (4-axis advisory scorer). ADVISORY INPUT — this file feeds a RANKING, never a gate. The scorer degrades gracefully on missing fields (records which were absent). Populate `candidates` by sourcing live programs (Code4rena / Sherlock / Cantina for Solana rust; Immunefi/HackenProof for EVM/TON).
_honesty_note: target_acquisition RANKS targets; the human SELECTS. It never routes, gates, submits, or sets severity. Axis-4 REJECTS already-seen / pre-cutoff targets so the recall number stays honest.

_field_schema.name: required — program/protocol name
_field_schema.cap: optional — max reward USD (power-law; higher=better EV)
_field_schema.tvl: optional — USD; very-high-TVL is a Digger target (archetype down-weight)
_field_schema.prior_criticals: optional — # prior Critical findings (MORE => more bugs likely)
_field_schema.basic_issue_density: optional — 0..1 sloppiness signal (MORE => more bugs likely)
_field_schema.assembly_unsafe: optional bool — assembly / unsafe / manual memory
_field_schema.active_bounty: optional bool — false => fewer eyes => more findable
_field_schema.reject_flags: optional [] — explicit 'What Not to Hunt': deprecated_unused, old_impl_behind_proxy, code_ne_deployed, non_live_chain, in_dev_unshipped, trusted_role_gated_only, temp_dos_griefing_only, third_party_gated, offchain_mitigated, informational_only

_sourced: 2026-07-06 PAYOUT-PATH sweep (operator chose live Solana bug bounty). Cantina bounties API (cantina.xyz/api/v0/bounties, 70 bounties w/ totalFindings as a less-reviewed proxy) + Immunefi scope pages (WebFetch-able) + gh repo verification. Filtered to LIVE + Solana on-chain rust + less-audited (low finding count / no prior audits) + meaningful cap. These are ONGOING bounties (no answer key) — payout path, not the eval/#5b bed.

candidates.name: OnRe (ONyc)
candidates._note: Immunefi $100k Crit/High. SINGLE Anchor program programs/onreapp (64 rust files, actively pushed 2026-07-03). Governs on-chain NAV + mint-authority + offer/take (incl take_offer_permissionless = attacker-reachable) + redemption + vault accounting. NO prior audits mentioned. ONyc = reinsurance-backed yield token. Public repo, PoC via litesvm/solana-program-test, KYC. TOP payout candidate: high cap x least-audited x focused single-program rust surface.
